question: What are the sector exposures for the Tech Innovation Fund?
How many portfolios do we have in total?
Show me the top 5 holdings by cost basis in the Growth Equity Fund

args.sql: SELECT s.symbol, s.company_name, h.cost_basis FROM holdings h JOIN portfolios p ON h.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Growth Equity Fund' ORDER BY h.cost_basis DESC LIMIT 5
args.title: Top 5 holdings by cost basis in Growth Equity Fund

question: For each portfolio, show the total value of Technology sector holdings and what percentage it represents of the total portfolio value

args.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM sectors WHERE sector_name = 'Technology') THEN h.quantity * s.current_price ELSE 0 END) AS tech_value, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS total_value, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM sectors WHERE sector_name = 'Technology') THEN h.quantity * s.current_price ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price), 2) AS tech_percentage FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id
args.title: Technology sector value and percentage per portfolio

question: Show the sector exposures of the largest portfolio by AUM

args.sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios ORDER BY total_aum DESC LIMIT 1
args.title: Largest portfolio by AUM
